title: Bug: Automation list broken after sorting
body:
This bug is present on the master release and the latest dev

Steps to recreate:

- Sort your automations
- When I choose and delete an automation, it deletes the one above or below and not the one I selected
- I cannot delete all automations until I exit aaps and restart it

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/4112129/60e37085-bac9-4f46-9f4f-e55a8d6ed946
